{{Quote|You're looking for a Bothan named Silm'an Voueen.|[[Rakir Banai]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RB" />}}
'''Silm'an Voueen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|You may recall that saboteur who said my current boss, Drik Bandrik, is a slaver. I need to know if that's true. I don't like slavers. I'd like you to meet with a Bothan spy who has the truth.|Rakir Banai, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RB" />}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Rakir Banai]] was tasked by his boss [[Drik Bandrik]] to protect his mining business from a saboteur. Banai thus hired a spacer who killed the saboteur [[Triggo Binz]] but the latter pretended before dying that Drik Bandrik was a [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]]. Rakir Banai thus hired Silm'an Voueen to discover the truth. The Bothan spy investigated and was able to confirm this information. Silm'an Voueen later met the spacer who worked for Rakir Banai. After the spacer defeated several thugs who attacked her, Silm'an Voueen delivered a datadisk with data describing Drik Bandrik's slave operation.<ref name="SWG:RB" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:SilmanVoueen-SWG.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Silm'an Voueen]]
Silm'an Voueen was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]].<ref name="SWG:RB" /> The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
